description: This file defines test pattern configurations and utility functions for identifying specific test files within a project, including unit tests, boundary tests, and plugin-dependent tests.

methods.name: isUnitConfigTestFile
methods.description: Determines if a given file is a unit configuration test file based on inclusion and exclusion patterns.

methods.name: isBundledPluginDependentUnitTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is part of the bundled plugin dependent unit test files list.

methods.name: isBoundaryTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is a boundary test file based on predefined list.
